snippet.title: Toon Shooters 2: Chapter 2 Gameplay - iOS/Android/tvOS
snippet.description:
App Store: https://goo.gl/I5LnQ9
Google Play: https://goo.gl/8606tn/apps/details?id=com.mooffgames.toonshooter2&hl=en
Available in 11 languages
2 New characters: Jonathan & the Messenger
5 New stages, player ratings and multiplayer flags.  Some balancing across the board, new players & multiplayer difficulty.

The arcade side-scrolling shmup, a modern classic. 

Single & Multiplayer, available on the App Store and Google Play

Composer: Matthew Pablo (www.mathewpablo.com)
Website : http://www.mooffgames.com
Facebook : http://www.facebook.com/mooffgames
Twitter : http://www.twitter.com/mooffgames
Youtube: http://www.youtube.com/mooffgames
